scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @clipscribe/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @clipscribe/worker
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @clipscribe/client
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run web -w @clipscribe/client
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @clipscribe/contracts && npm run build -w @clipscribe/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @clipscribe/api && npm run build -w @clipscribe/worker
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web -w @clipscribe/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
